description: Spec 012 T006 extension of configs/phase4/tracker-grid.json, declared after the first grid's best IMM sat on its upper edges in r_scale (4) and p0_scale (4) (the top of stage 1 was flat in sigma_cv and sigma_ct, 9.2–9.4%). Same objective and rows; the EKF is re-scored on a widened r_scale and p0_scale too. The better of the two grids' winners is frozen in the decision record.
